in_marathi.name: Kanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Protection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kanta is the goddess of love, compassion, and protection. She is also known as Goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva. Kanta is revered for her unwavering love, nurturing nature, and ability to bestow blessings upon her devotees.
